name: Rice Milk
siboNotes: Rice milk is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets as a lactose-free milk alternative.
preparationTips: Choose unsweetened varieties to avoid added sugars
Shake well before use as ingredients naturally separate
Use in cereals, smoothies, or baking as 1:1 milk substitute
Store refrigerated and use within 7-10 days after opening
nutritionalHighlights: Often fortified with calcium and vitamin D
Lower in protein than dairy milk
